title: Real Estate Video Editor — Luxury Properties | Final Cut Pro | Long-Term
description:
Company: WorldClass Creative

Location: Remote (Philippines preferred)

Type: Full-time contractor

Pay: Base + performance bonuses (details below)



About This Role

WorldClass Creative produces cinematic listing content for the $1M–$10M+ South Florida luxury real estate market. We work with high-end agents and developers in Palm Beach County, shooting properties that range from waterfront estates to new-construction residences.



We're hiring editors for our post-production division. You will edit raw drone, interior, and exterior footage into polished listing reels and cinematic videos. You won't be shooting. You won't be managing clients. You'll edit, and you'll get good at our style fast.



This is a long-term position. We're building a team, and the editors who prove themselves early will have first access to higher-tier projects and creative direction work as we grow.



The Work:

You'll produce two types of deliverables from raw 4K footage we provide:



- Listing Reels (Vertical / 9:16)

- 60–90 second social-format reels for Instagram. Shot selection, music, color grade, pacing. These are the bread and butter.

- You'll edit 2–3 of these per day once you're ramped.

- Cinematic Horizontal Videos (16:9)

- 2–4 minute listing walkthroughs. Slower pace, more room to breathe. These take longer per piece but the footage is usually stronger.



Typical daily output after your first two weeks: 2–3 completed videos. We provide the footage, music library, LUTs, and templates. You bring the edit instincts and the speed.



Requirements:

Final Cut Pro 11+ — this is non-negotiable. Our template library, LUT workflow, and project structure are built around FCP. If you edit in Premiere and want to switch, that's fine, but you need to be comfortable in FCP before your first project.



1–3 years editing real estate or architectural video. Wedding, travel, and corporate reels don't count. We need someone who already knows how luxury property footage should move, breathe, and cut. If your portfolio doesn't have at least 3 real estate edits, this isn't the right fit.



Strong color grading instincts. You know the difference between warm-and-inviting interiors and orange-tinted mistakes. You can match shots across rooms without everything looking like the same filter. You grade for accuracy first, mood second.

A computer that handles 4K without choking. No proxy-only workflows. You need to be able to scrub through 4K drone footage and interior clips without lag. If your machine can't do that, this role will frustrate you.



Reliable internet and a quiet workspace. We communicate async through Frame.io and messaging. You need to upload finished exports (150–250MB files) without it taking all day.



Available 9AM–1PM Eastern (US) for overlap. The rest of your hours are flexible. But during that 4-hour window, you respond to messages and feedback within 30 minutes.



What You Don't Need:

You don't need to talk to clients. David handles all client communication.

You don't need to own a camera or any recording equipment.



Compensation:

Guaranteed base: $1,400 USD/month

Volume bonuses (stack on top of base):



Videos 9–20/month: +$25 per video

Videos 21–35/month: +$30 per video

Videos 36+/month: +$35 per video



Quality bonus: $100–$200/month



We score every edit on a 100-point quality scorecard. Average score of 85+ earns $100/month. Score of 92+ earns $200/month.



What this looks like in practice:



Learning - 20 videos/month (ramp period) ~$1,675

Consistent 85+ - 35 videos/month - ~$2,275

Scoring 90+ - 45 videos/month - ~ $2,950

Scoring 92+ - 55 videos/month - ~$3,550



Your earnings scale directly with your speed and quality. Editors who produce more and score higher make more. No cap on volume bonuses.



Payment: bi-weekly via Gusto



Our Standards:

We edit luxury real estate. The audience is buyers considering a $3M home purchase. Every frame matters.



How We Work:

Frame.io for project delivery and review. You upload exports, David leaves timestamped feedback, you revise.

Async communication. No daily standups. No Zoom calls unless something specific needs a screen share. You post a daily status update ("On track, delivering 3 edits by 9AM EST" or "Flagging an issue with the drone footage on Project X"). Short messages, clear information.



Feedback loop. Your first two weeks are supervised. David reviews every edit against the scorecard and walks you through the gaps. After 2 weeks, if your scores are consistently 80+, you move to independent delivery. David spot-checks rather than reviewing every project.



Folder structure and naming conventions are standardized. We'll give you the full system on Day 1. Every project is organized the same way. No improvisation on file management.



How to Apply

Send three things:



Your portfolio link. Must include at least 3 real estate video edits. If your portfolio is "available on request," don't apply.

A short note (3–5 sentences) answering this: Pick one of your RE edits and tell me what creative decision you made that you're most proud of, and one thing you'd change if you could redo it.



Your expected monthly rate and current availability (part-time or full-time).



Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. One-line applications ("I'm interested, here's my resume") will not be reviewed. If you made it this far in the description, please add the word 'Banana' in the title of the
.



Timeline



We review applications within 5 business days

Top candidates receive a trial edit for a 60-second reel from our raw footage

Trial is scored on our 100-point quality scorecard

If you pass (75+), we make an offer and start onboarding





About WorldClass Creative

We're a boutique luxury real estate media company based in West Palm Beach, Florida.



This editing division is new. You'd be one of the first editors on the team. That means more direct access to David, more input on how things get built, and more room to grow as we scale. It also means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity in the early weeks while processes solidify.



If that sounds like your kind of environment, apply.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
If you understand what video hooks work, why pacing matters, and how editing decisions move performance metrics, this role was built for you.



This is not an execution role. You won't be handed timestamps or told what footage to pull. You'll read a brief, make strong editorial calls, and ship high-performing paid social creatives at volume across Meta and TikTok.



The creative strategists own the concept and messaging. You own the pacing, footage selection, hook strength, platform feel, and variations fast enough to fuel aggressive testing cycles.



WHO THEY ARE

You’ll be working with fast-growing DTC brands and performance creative teams scaling aggressively across Meta and TikTok.



These brands operate in categories like wellness, beauty, supplements, fashion, personal care, and consumer products, all heavily focused on direct-response advertising, creative testing, and paid social scale. Most are spending aggressively on Meta and rely on fast iteration, high-volume testing, and performance-focused creative to drive growth.



The teams operate with a lean, performance-driven culture where creativity is judged by results, not aesthetics. Editors are trusted to think independently, move quickly, collaborate closely with strategists and media buyers, and continuously improve output based on performance feedback.



This is a fully remote, full-time role.



WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

- Work with fast-growing DTC brands: Join ecommerce teams scaling aggressively through paid social advertising

- Multiple immediate openings: Get matched with brands actively looking for editors right now

- Creative ownership: Make real editorial decisions instead of acting as a production executor

- Performance-focused environments: Work on ads designed specifically for testing, iteration, and measurable results

- AI-driven workflows: Use modern AI tools for voiceovers, captioning, B-roll generation, and production acceleration

- Growth opportunities: Potential to evolve into Senior Editor, Creative Strategist, or leadership roles as the brands continue scaling

- Remote flexibility: Fully remote opportunities focused on output and execution rather than micromanagement



WHAT YOU’RE GETTING INTO

- Edit direct-response video ads for Meta, TikTok, and paid social placements using AI UGC, testimonials, product demos, B-roll, and creator footage

- Apply direct-response editing principles, including hooks, pacing, retention management, CTA placement, and conversion-focused sequencing

- Create multiple creative variations across hooks, pacing, visuals, CTAs, and angles to support testing cycles

- Independently interpret creative briefs and select the strongest footage and visuals for each concept

- Produce platform-native creative optimized for Reels, TikTok feeds, Shorts, and paid placements

- Use AI-assisted workflows for voiceovers, captioning, B-roll generation, and creative optimization

- Source music, overlays, stock footage, and supporting assets that improve engagement and conversion performance

- Collaborate closely with Creative Strategists, media buyers, and founders to improve creative quality and performance outcomes

- Deliver high-volume creative output while maintaining strong quality and fast turnaround times





WHO YOU ARE

- You have experience editing direct-response or paid social ads for Meta, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts for high-spend DTC ecommerce brands.

- You understand direct-response editing deeply, including hooks, pacing, retention, engagement flow, and conversion-focused storytelling

- You have experience with motion graphics, VSLs, or AI-generated creative workflows

- You are familiar with performance metrics like hook rate, hold rate, thumbstop rate, CTR, and creative fatigue

- You can independently turn a creative brief into a polished ad without needing every shot pre-selected

- You have strong instincts for Reels/TikTok-native editing styles and modern paid social creative

- You are proficient with Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Frame.io, Slack, and Google Drive

- You are comfortable using AI-assisted editing workflows and emerging creative production tools

- You can manage high creative output without sacrificing quality or attention to detail

- You communicate clearly, take feedback professionally, and thrive in fast-moving remote environments

- You are fluent in English



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

30 Days: Understand the brand’s creative workflows, editing standards, and direct-response frameworks while producing video concepts independently.

60 Days: Consistently deliver high-performing concepts with strong pacing, hooks, creative variation, and efficient feedback implementation.

90 Days: Operate independently with a reliable production rhythm, contribute stronger creative ideas proactively, and consistently support performance goals through your editing decisions.

title: GoHighLevel Build Executor — Mortgage Automation System (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
READ THIS FIRST

This is not an architect's role. The systems are already designed. The workflows, copy, doc lists, and pipeline logic are already written. Your job is to build exactly what I hand you, click by click, inside GoHighLevel, and build it correctly the first time.

If you want to design systems from scratch and make creative decisions, this role may not be for you.

If you love executing detailed build specs, clicking through GHL with precision, catching small inconsistencies, and watching automations come to life, keep reading.



THE PROJECT

I'm building a complete mortgage lead capture and nurture system in GoHighLevel for a US-based Senior Loan Officer in Phoenix, Arizona. The system handles:



Inbound mortgage leads from a landing page form

Bilingual (English + Spanish)
 + SMS nurture sequences

AI conversation bot for borrower questions

Booking integration with the loan team

Dynamic document request workflows based on borrower type (W-2, Self-Employed, VA, Refinance, HELOC)

Realtor partner update notifications

Pipeline stage progression with milestone communications

Long-term nurture for cold leads





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING

I will hand you detailed, step-by-step build specs. Every workflow node. Every condition. Every
 body. Every SMS message. Every tag. Every custom field value. Your job is to execute them inside GoHighLevel with zero deviation.

Typical week:



Building and editing workflows in GoHighLevel (If/Else conditions, wait timers,
 actions, SMS actions, tag actions, pipeline stage moves)

Configuring pipelines, opportunities, tags, and custom fields exactly as specified

Setting up
 templates with merge fields, footers, and reply-to addresses

Configuring SMS templates with custom values and merge fields

Managing A2P 10DLC registrations end-to-end — brand registration, campaign builds, sample message review, handling carrier rejections and resubmissions, monitoring trust scores. As we productize this system into a resellable snapshot, every new Loan Officer client who buys it will need their own A2P 10DLC setup. You will own this process.

Building forms and embedding them on landing pages

Setting up webhooks and verifying they fire correctly

Configuring calendars and booking links

Testing every workflow end-to-end with test submissions before marking it done

Recording short Loom videos showing me what you built so I can verify it matches spec

Documenting any deviations or questions (don't guess — ask)

Cleaning up orphan workflow branches, broken conditions, and inconsistent tags

Maintaining a clean snapshot ready for resale to other Loan Officers





NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS

You must have:



2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience — not "I watched tutorials," actual building inside client sub-accounts

Strong understanding of GHL workflows: triggers, If/Else conditions, Wait actions, Send
, Send SMS, Add/Remove Tag, Update Contact Field, Find Opportunity, Go To actions

Custom fields and custom values — you know the difference and when to use each

Pipeline and opportunity management — moving opportunities between stages via workflows

Webhook trigger experience — receiving form data via webhook and mapping it to contact fields


 and SMS template building with merge fields and custom values

A2P 10DLC verification expertise — you have personally taken at least one client through the full A2P 10DLC registration process inside GoHighLevel and gotten approved. You know:



How to register the brand (EIN, business info, website, privacy policy requirements)

How to build the campaign and write sample messages that pass carrier review

What gets campaigns rejected (vague opt-in language, missing STOP/HELP, mismatched use case, weak privacy policy) and how to fix it

How to handle resubmissions when carriers push back

Trust score implications and how to improve a low score

The difference between brand approval and campaign approval, and what each unlocks





Strong written English — you'll read detailed specs and need to communicate clearly when something is unclear

Extreme attention to detail — a tag spelled "Lead Captured" vs "lead-captured" silently breaks a workflow. You catch that before I do.

Self-discipline to follow instructions exactly — if the spec says "wait 30 minutes," you don't change it to 1 hour because you think it's better

Reliable internet + quiet workspace + ability to record Loom videos





NICE TO HAVE (BONUS POINTS)



Spanish language skills (the system is bilingual — knowing Spanish lets you spot if Spanish copy is wrong, but I'll handle Spanish QA myself if you don't)

Mortgage industry exposure

Experience with Arive (mortgage LOS) — we'll be syncing GHL ? Arive in Sprint 2

Zapier or Make.com experience for integrations

Snapshot creation and white-label deployment experience

AI bot configuration inside GHL (Conversation AI / playbooks)





THE PERSON I'M LOOKING FOR

Green flags:



You test your own work before saying "done"

You record a quick Loom showing what you built — you don't make me hunt for it

You ask clarifying questions before building, not after breaking something

You spot inconsistencies in specs and flag them

You say "I don't know that, but I can learn it" instead of pretending

You hit deadlines and communicate when you can't

You treat the GHL account like your own business



Red flags (don't apply if):



You need someone holding your hand on every click

You change things "because you thought it was better" without asking

You disappear for days without communication

You exaggerate your GHL experience

You wait for instructions instead of executing the spec in front of you





COMPENSATION + GROWTH



Starting: $300–$400/month for 20 hours/week (rate based on experience proven in interview)

Performance bonuses when we hit launch milestones

Raises as you prove yourself and take on more responsibility

Long-term role — when the snapshot productization scales, the person who knows the system best becomes more valuable, not less

Paid time off and holidays added over time for long-term team members





HOW TO APPLY

Send a message with ALL of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed — this is the first test of whether you follow detailed instructions.

1. Start your message with the exact phrase: "PURPLE MORTGAGE"

(This proves you read the full post. No "purple mortgage," no "Purple-Mortgage," no creative variations. Exact match.)

2. A short paragraph (3–5 sentences) about your GoHighLevel experience: how many years, what types of clients/industries you've built for, and what you'd say is your strongest skill inside GHL.

3. A 2–4 minute Loom video walking me through ONE workflow you've personally built inside GoHighLevel. Show me the canvas, explain what each node does, and tell me what problem the workflow solved. No Loom = no review. If you've never built a workflow you can show, this role is not for you.

4. Answer this question in writing:



A form submits to a GHL webhook. The form sends a field called preferred_language with values english or spanish. The workflow has an If/Else condition checking if Preferred Language (custom field) equals English. After submission, the contact is created correctly but the workflow always goes down the "None" branch even for English leads. What are the top 3 things you would check to debug this?



5. Answer this A2P 10DLC question in writing (this is non-negotiable — your answer tells me immediately whether you've actually done this work):



A client's A2P 10DLC campaign was rejected by the carrier with the reason: "Sample messages do not match the registered use case and opt-in language is unclear." The use case is "Mortgage Lead Follow-Up" and the sample SMS reads: "Hey John, this is Tony from GX4. Got your info — call me back at
when you can."

(a) Why did this get rejected?

(b) What specific changes would you make to the sample message to get it approved on resubmission?

(c) What else on the website or form might the carrier be flagging?



6. Tell me about one client you took through A2P 10DLC registration. How long did it take? Was it approved on first submission or did you have to resubmit? What was the hardest part?

7. Your weekly availability in PH time, and how many hours per week overlap with US Pacific Time (Phoenix / Arizona).

8. Your internet speed test link (speedtest.net result screenshot or link).

9. Your monthly rate expectation for 20 hours/week.



FINAL NOTE

This role is for executors, people who love being given a clear plan and bringing it to life flawlessly. The system architecture is locked. The copy is written. The workflows are designed. What I need is a precision builder who can take my specs and turn them into working automation, week after week, while the snapshot grows into a resellable product.

If you're that person, I'd love to meet you.



Looking forward to your application ????

)

We have additional Rev1 Digital services in the pipeline (full IDX site, AI assistants, lead-gen automation — a kvCore replacement stack), but BROKERUPGRADE is what is live and selling today. Focus your energy here.



WHO YOU SELL TO

- Broker-owners of small-to-mid US real estate brokerages

- Recruiting brokers and team leaders at larger shops

- Anyone whose KPI is "agents added this quarter"

You are NOT pitching individual agents. You are pitching the person whose job is to recruit agents.



COMPENSATION

- Base: $50/week, paid weekly regardless of sales

- Commission per signup: $20 the first month + $10/month for the following 5 months, paid only if the subscriber stays active. Total = up to $70 per signup over 6 months.

- No cap on number of signups. Stack them.

- Start part-time (~20 hrs/wk). Move to full-time once production is consistent.



YOU MUST HAVE

- 2+ years selling SaaS, ideally to SMB or real estate

- Near-native English — you will be on Zoom with US broker-owners

- Comfort with CRMs (we use GoHighLevel), Zoom demos, structured follow-up

- Working knowledge of US real estate brokerage economics: splits, caps, desk fees, recruiting incentives, stock/equity programs (eXp, Real, Epique models)

- A recruiting mindset — you are helping brokers solve THEIR recruiting problem, not feature-dumping software



NICE TO HAVE

)

- Existing relationships with US broker-owners or team leaders

- Worked on the recruiting side at a brokerage yourself



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — generic replies are ignored)

Leave credits

This is not a basic talking-head reel or captions job. I need someone who understands how to match the emotion, lyrics, rhythm, and vibe of a song with the right movie or TV scenes.



The style is similar to TikTok/Reels fan edits, cinematic music edits, and short-form montage edits where a song clip is paired with famous movie or TV footage to create something emotional, nostalgic, dramatic, romantic, intense, or visually powerful.

A 30–60 second audio clip from an artist on TikTok

The type of movie, TV show, or genre I want the visuals to match

You will then create a polished short video using the audio and matching it with the right scenes, pacing, transitions, and overall vibe.

title: Account Manager - Business Funding
description:
Verna Capital is a high-growth business funding consultancy. We help ambitious entrepreneurs, real estate investors, and e-commerce operators secure the capital they need to scale—primarily through 0% interest credit card stacking, lines of credit, SBA loans, and alternative financing.



We operate differently than the rest of the funding space. We don't push products based on commission; we build custom, bank-by-bank funding strategies based on our clients' actual credit profiles and business needs. We are consultative, relationship-driven, and highly structured.



As we scale, we are looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed Business Funding Account Manager to take ownership of our fulfillment pipeline and become the primary point of contact for our clients post-sale.







The Role



This is not a passive "check-in" customer success role. You are the operator who takes the baton from our sales team, analyzes the client's credit profile, builds their funding game plan, and guides them through the application process to secure maximum capital.



You will manage a capped book of 30 active clients (quality over volume), ensuring every client moves smoothly through our 8-stage pipeline from onboarding to post-approval capital maximization.











What You Will Do



•Client Intake & Onboarding: Take immediate handoff from sales, send welcome materials, pull credit reports, and run the onboarding call to set expectations.



•Credit Analysis & Strategy: Read full tri-bureau credit reports to identify utilization issues, inquiries, and fundability blockers. Build custom, sequenced funding game plans based on current bank rules and underwriting criteria.



•Application Execution: Run live application sessions with clients via Zoom or TeamViewer. Ensure flawless, batch-submitted applications with zero mismatched data points.



•Pipeline Management: Own the client status board in our CRM. Ensure no client goes silent for more than 3 days. Surface pipeline risks, stuck clients, and escalations to leadership weekly.



•Client Communication: Serve as the single point of contact. Hold strict response time SLAs (24 hours Mon-Fri). Handle hard conversations cleanly, including denials, low limits, and expectation resets.



•Post-Approval Maximization: Run post-approval calls to review limits, APRs, and 0% promo terms.



Coach clients on optimal card usage, collect testimonials, and identify upsell opportunities for future funding rounds.



•Process Improvement: Surface gaps in our SOPs, help refine internal workflows, and eventually help train future Account Managers as we grow the team.







What Success Looks Like



•30 Days: Fully onboarded, shadowing all calls, game plan templates internalized, and our internal knowledge base read end-to-end.



•60 Days: Running onboarding and game plan calls solo, executing applications via TeamViewer, and managing 10+ active clients.



•90 Days: Full pipeline ownership for all post-sale clients, maintaining a 90%+ on-time response SLA, collecting your first batch of testimonials, and actively contributing to SOP improvements.







Required Skills & Experience



•2+ years in a client-facing Account Manager, Customer Success, or high-touch operations role at a service business.



•Demonstrated ability to manage 20+ active client relationships simultaneously without dropping the ball.



•Excellent written and verbal communication—capable of handling calls,
s, and texts at a highly professional level.



•Comfortable with screen-share and remote tools (Zoom, TeamViewer, Loom, Google Workspace).



•CRM proficiency (GoHighLevel, Monday.com, HubSpot, or similar).



•Self-managed and capable of working independently without daily handholding.







Strongly Preferred



•Background in finance, lending, credit, or business funding.



•Experience working with credit reports, FICO scores, and underwriting concepts.



•Prior exposure to credit card stacking, business funding, SBA, or commercial lending.



•Experience running client-facing calls in a coaching or done-for-you service business.







Who Should NOT Apply



•Anyone who needs a script for every conversation.



•Anyone who has never managed a book of clients.



•Anyone whose last role was purely passive (data entry, scheduling, generic admin).



•Anyone who cannot explain what a "hard inquiry" is on day one of training.







Personality & Soft Skills



•Sharp: Picks up new concepts fast, especially in finance.



•Locked-in: Owns outcomes and doesn't punt blame.



•Calm under pressure: Steady and reassuring when clients call upset or stressed.



•Direct communicator: No fluff, no over-apologizing, no over-promising.



•Detail-obsessed: Understands that one wrong data point on an application equals a denial.



•Coachable: The funding game changes monthly; ego will get you killed.

title: AutoCAD Drafter— Traffic Control Plans
description:
We're commissioning a series of traffic control plans (work zone / road-work TCPs) based on existing reference standards. We need an experienced CAD drafter for an ongoing project, starting with a small paid trial.



What this involves:

- Working from a set of standard reference drawings that we'll provide.

- For each one, producing matched sets — a reference version that follows the source standard exactly, plus several variations of it that deliberately deviate from the standard in specific, controlled ways.

- Each plan must be produced in AutoCAD at actual scale, with the DXF model space in feet. The geometry must match the labels: if a distance is labeled "320 ft," the measured distance between the relevant sign insertion points in the DXF must equal 320 ft. This is the most important requirement of the project — many drafters label distances without actually drawing them to scale, and that won't work here.

- For each plan, also producing a sidecar annotation file (JSON) recording the key dimensions used and, for the deviating versions, what was changed and where (with DXF coordinates).

- Final output per plan: a layered DXF file in feet, plus the matching JSON file.



Trial: We start with a small paid batch (6 plans from a single source). If the work is good, we scale up significantly from there — hundreds of plans over the following months.



Pricing structure:

- The 6-plan trial: paid at an agreed rate.

- After the trial, the next ~10–15 plans are paid hourly while you build templates and internalize the workflow.

- Once you're producing plans steadily, we switch to a per-plan rate based on your actual time during the hourly phase. The per-plan rate is structured so your effective hourly earnings stay higher than during ramp-up — efficient work pays off.



Requirements:

- Strong AutoCAD proficiency. Comfortable working in DXF/DWG with model-space units in feet, and you understand block insertion points.

- Ability to read technical standards and apply them precisely — looking up values in tables, following the right formulas for the right cases.

- Attention to detail. Geometry must match labels exactly. We will verify by measuring the DXF.

- Comfortable producing structured JSON files alongside CAD output.

- Good English communication.



Helpful but not required:

- Prior experience with traffic control plans, work zone drawings, or U.S.-style roadway standards.



How to apply:

1. Share a sample of CAD work where the geometry is drawn to actual scale — ideally a traffic or roadway-related plan, but any precision engineering CAD is fine.

2. Tell us your hourly rate.

3. Estimated turnaround for the 6-plan trial.

4. In 2–3 sentences, confirm you understand the "geometry must match labels at actual scale in DXF model space" requirement and how you'd verify it before delivery.



Applications that don't address point 4 will not be considered.

title: Updated: Senior EA / Operations VA for US Medical Consulting Firm — Policy & SOP Review, Notion, Long-Term
description:
Updated Description: Senior EA / Operations VA for US Medical Consulting Firm — Policy & SOP Review, Notion, Long-Term



I have updated the description from my prior job posting, and including questions specifically related to QBO, Outlook, Zapier, Notion, and Healthcare experience. 



I'm a physician and medical director based in Colorado, US. I own a single-physician PLLC that provides medical director services and NP/PA supervision to clinics across multiple US states (IV hydration, med spa, aesthetics, GLP-1, primary care).



I'm hiring one senior person to own the day-to-day operations so I can focus on the medical, compliance, and growth side of the business. This is a long-term, embedded role. If you're looking for a 3-month gig, this isn't it. If you're looking for a business owner you can grow with for years, we may be a good fit.



What you'll own



Policy and SOP review. I have a library of clinic policies, standing orders, supervision agreements, and internal SOPs that support a multi-state practice. I will need you to review them, flag gaps, track versions, and propose edits. You don't need to be a lawyer or clinician, just be willing and able to look up normal policies and compare.



Inbox monitoring and drafting. I get 30 to 60 inbound
s per day. Most are noise; a few are real new-client inquiries, state board notices, or NP/PA collaboration requests. You'll triage, draft responses in my voice for me to approve, and surface what actually needs my attention.



Calendar and scheduling. Managing my availability across consults, clinic onboardings, and personal time.



Occasional client text messages. Same voice-matching skill as
, lower volume.



Client and CRM organization. Keeping records of every clinic, NP, and PA I work with, including contract status, state, audit cadence, supervision agreement renewal dates. This will likely be an automated process we'll be building around; I'm hiring a contractor to build us a program from the ground up.



Google Drive cleanup and ongoing structure. 1.5 years of accumulated documents across multiple state PLLCs need a clean folder taxonomy with naming conventions and version control.



Filtering inbound offers. New clinic inquiries, NP/PA collaboration requests, vendor pitches, and partnership offers come in regularly. You'll triage these against a checklist I'll teach you, surface the real opportunities, and bring the ones with potential to my attention.



Eventually: light QuickBooks Online work, basic AP/AR and invoicing for the PLLC. Training provided if you don't have QBO experience but understand bookkeeping fundamentals.



Tools we use



- Notion (primary source of truth, must have hands-on experience, not just exposure)

- Zapier (current automations; willing to train someone strong who hasn't used it yet)

- Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets)

- Microsoft Outlook and Calendar

- QuickBooks Online (training provided if you have bookkeeping fundamentals)

- ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity (AI assistance is encouraged, not banned)



What I'm looking for



- 2+ years of real EA or operations VA experience supporting US-based founders, executives, or business owners

- Strong written English, you'll be drafting in my voice and writing to physicians, attorneys, and clinic owners

- Comfortable in healthcare-adjacent work (HIPAA awareness expected; clinical background not required but a plus)

- Proactive, you flag issues early and propose solutions, you don't wait to be asked

- Organized to the point of being a little annoying about it (this is a compliment)

- Discreet, you'll see sensitive business and patient-adjacent information

- Available long-term, full-time, with at least some overlap with US business hours preferred



Who you are not



- Looking for project-based or short-term work

- A pure social media manager, content creator, or copywriter (those skills are nice but not the job)

- Hoping to grow into a clinical role (this is admin-first and will stay that way)

- A generalist who'll need everything explained from scratch, I want someone who walks in with judgment



How to apply



Send me a message that includes all four of the following. Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed:



1. Briefly tell me about yourself, not a resume dump, just who you are and why this role caught your eye.



2. Walk me through how you'd approach the first 30 days of inbox triage for someone like me, assuming you have access to my inbox and a brief intro to my business. What would you set up first?



3. Explicitly state your hands-on experience with each of the following. For each one, tell me how many years you've used it, what you've actually done with it, and rate yourself: none, basic, intermediate, or advanced. Don't lump them together, give me one line per item.

   - EA or operations VA experience (years supporting US-based founders, executives, or business owners; lead clients you've worked with)

   - QuickBooks Online

   - Microsoft Outlook

   - Zapier

   - Notion

   - Healthcare or HIPAA-adjacent work



4. One question you have for me. Anyone who asks zero questions about the role isn't curious enough for this hire.



I read every application that follows these instructions, and I'll respond within 3 business days to candidates I think would be a good match.



Looking forward to hearing from you.



— Thomas

title: Product & Ad Researcher — Meta Ads Library / Trendtrack (Dropshipiping Company)
description:
We run two beauty and health e-commerce brands targeting a 40+ audience. We're looking for a researcher who can consistently find ads for products that are already proven and actively scaling — meaning campaigns with significant spend behind them, multiple creatives running, and clear traction in the market right now.



This is not a product discovery role. We are not looking for untested products or early signals. We want ads for products that are already winning — your job is to find them, document them, and deliver structured swipe files we can build our own creatives from.



What you'll do:

Search Meta Ads Library and Trendtrack for products with active, scaled campaigns — high spend signals, multiple ad variants, long run times

Identify advertisers who are clearly investing heavily in a product right now, not just testing

Deliver structured swipe reports per ad: product, hook summary, angle, format, estimated spend signal, and why it's working

Flag recurring hooks and angles across multiple advertisers in the same niche — patterns matter

Submit research on a consistent daily/weekly schedule with clean, organised output





What we're looking for:

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Library and Trendtrack — you know how to read spend signals, creative volume, and ad longevity

Ability to tell the difference between a product being tested and a product being scaled — this is the core skill

Basic understanding of direct-response hooks and angles (you don't need to write them, but you need to recognise them)

Experience in beauty, health, or supplement e-commerce is a strong plus

Reliable and self-managed — delivers clean output without follow-up needed



What to include in your application:

Brief overview of your experience with Meta Ads Library and Trendtrack specifically

A sample swipe file or research output — show us how you identify a scaled winner, not just any ad you found

The niches you've researched most

Your availability and preferred rate

title: Amazon Private Label Operations Specialist
description:
Position: Amazon Private Label Operations Specialist

Type: Full-Time, Remote/Hybrid (Philippines)

Salary: PHP 30,000 – 45,000 / month, depending on experience

Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours, with flexibility for supplier and Amazon-related communication



About our Company



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade and e-commerce. We are operating in the global market, and we want to utilize global ecommerce platforms such as Amazon to develop new brands and products and reach out to customers across globe. Our company values professionalism, data-driven decision-making, and long-term partnerships. We are establishing a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.



Role Overview



We are seeking an Amazon Private Label Operations Specialist who can support the full Amazon private label process from product research and supplier sourcing through listing preparation, launch execution, post-launch monitoring, inventory coordination, and ongoing Amazon account support.



This is an execution-focused role for someone with direct Amazon FBA or Amazon private label experience. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable with Amazon tools and Seller Central workflows, and able to move tasks forward without constant supervision.



NOTE: General VA, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, customer service, or non-Amazon e-commerce experience alone is not suitable for this role. Candidates must have direct Amazon experience.



Key Responsibilities:



• Conduct Amazon product research using tools such as Helium 10, Keepa, Amazon search, and other available Amazon research tools.

• Analyze Amazon product demand, pricing, competition, reviews, profitability, keyword opportunities, and launch difficulty.

• Source and communicate with suppliers through Alibaba, 1688, Global Sources, and other sourcing platforms.

• Request and compare supplier quotes, MOQ, lead time, sample cost, customization options, packaging options, and shipping details.

• Support product development by organizing supplier information, product specifications, sample notes, cost comparisons, and improvement opportunities.

• Review customer feedback and competitor listings to identify product improvements, common complaints, differentiation opportunities, and positioning ideas.

• Support Amazon listing preparation, including keyword research, title and bullet point inputs, image requirements, A+ content inputs, competitor listing review, and product positioning.

• Coordinate with designers, copywriters, PPC specialists, suppliers, prep centers, freight forwarders, or other contractors when needed.

• Assist with Amazon launch preparation, including listing readiness, inventory planning, shipment coordination, launch checklist tracking, and follow-up on missing items.

• Support Amazon Seller Central operations, including listing monitoring, account health checks, suppressed listing follow-up, inventory status review, customer feedback monitoring, and issue tracking.

• Monitor post-launch performance, including sales, keyword movement, conversion signals, customer reviews, returns, stock level, pricing, PPC coordination, and competitor activity.

• Prepare clear reports, updates, and action lists for management review.

• Keep Google Drive, Google Sheets, supplier records, product files, and Amazon operation trackers organized and updated.

• Flag risks, mistakes, delays, supplier issues, listing issues, inventory issues, or Amazon account concerns early.



Qualifications:



• 2-4 years of direct Amazon FBA or Amazon private label experience required; candidates with 4+ years of relevant Amazon experience are preferred.

• Experience with Amazon product research, Amazon listing preparation, supplier sourcing, and Amazon operations support.

• Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Keepa, Alibaba, Google Sheets, and Google Drive.

• Strong understanding of Amazon product research, keyword research, competitor analysis, review analysis, pricing, and profitability checks.

• Experience communicating with suppliers and following up professionally.

• Strong English communication skills, especially in writing.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to follow SOPs and structured processes.

• Comfortable using spreadsheets, templates, checklists, AI tools, and Amazon research tools while verifying information carefully.

• Able to work independently, manage multiple product tasks, and provide clear updates.

• Must be comfortable with both pre-launch and post-launch Amazon private label operations.

• Must be up-to-date with AI tools and actively use them to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, decision-making, and workflow speed.





KPIs / Success Measures:



• Accurate and timely completion of Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, and operation files.

• Quality of supplier outreach, quote comparison, sample coordination, and follow-up.

• Accuracy of Amazon market data, competitor analysis, keyword research, and listing preparation inputs.

• Clear and timely communication of blockers, risks, next steps, and completed work.

• Improvement in workflow speed, file organization, and task completion quality.

• Low error rate in data entry, supplier details, Amazon listing details, and research reports.

• Reliable support across product research, sourcing, launch preparation, Seller Central follow-up, and post-launch monitoring.

• Ability to identify issues early before they affect launch timing, listing quality, inventory availability, or account performance.

• Consistent, organized daily updates and clear reporting to management.

• Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards.





What We Offer:



• Full-time remote work opportunity with a Canadian company.

• Long-term opportunity as the Amazon private label business grows.

• Structured SOPs, templates, and workflow support.

• Direct communication with company management.

• Opportunity to work across the full Amazon private label process from product research to post-launch operations.

• Performance-based growth opportunities.

title: AI Automation & Workflow Specialist

Make | Zapier | n8n | Notion | Airtable | OpenAI | Google Workspace | WhatsApp Business | Claude / Claude Code

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Strong fit if you:

- think in systems and workflows

- communicate clearly

- document your work well

- simplify messy processes

- proactively suggest improvements

- are organized and reliable

- understand automation logic

- enjoy operational problem solving



Bonus if you have experience with:



- AI workflows

- content operations

- social media systems

- CRM systems

- API integrations

- prompt engineering



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



We are looking for a long-term collaborator who can grow with the studio over time.

Focus: Building the operational foundation of the studio.



Responsibilities may include:



• building AI workflows

• setting up automations

• organizing internal systems

• documenting processes

• optimizing repetitive operations

___________________________________________________

• maintaining workflows

• troubleshooting automation issues

• optimizing operational systems

• refining prompts and workflows

• improving efficiency

Compensation: USD $8–12/hour depending on ownership and performance



This phase may be structured as: hourly, retainer or project-based



___________________________________________________



Stage 3 — Long-Term Systems Partner



The ideal long-term collaborator is someone who can become a trusted operational and systems partner for the studio.



This may include:



• proactively improving workflows

• helping scale operations

• reducing admin friction

• supporting future automation initiatives

• improving operational efficiency continuously



Compensation:

USD $10–15+/hour depending on strategic contribution and leadership



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Documentation & System Design Expectations



We highly value:



• clean workflows

• modular systems

• thoughtful operational design

• clear documentation

• maintainable automation architecture



Important:

Systems should be built in a way that can be easily understood, maintained, and improved by future tea
mbers if needed.



We prefer:

• simple and scalable workflows

• organized databases and naming structures

• modular automations

• clear SOPs and Loom walkthroughs

over overly complex or difficult-to-maintain systems.



All workflows, automations, SOPs, prompts, databases, and operational systems created for Reeljoy will belong to the company upon payment.



Additional expectations:

• All systems will be built inside company-owned accounts/workspaces

• Documentation is required for every major workflow

• Clear naming conventions should be used

• Workflows should avoid unnecessary complexity

• Systems should be transferable and maintainable long-term



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



How to Apply



Please send your application to: 



Include:

1. Resume / portfolio / LinkedIn

2. 1–3 examples of workflows or automations you’ve built (screenshots, Loom videos, or short explanations are fine)



Please answer:



1. What’s the most useful workflow you’ve built and why?

2. If you were helping a content studio become more efficient, what would you automate first?

3. How do you usually document the systems you build?



Shortlisted candidates will go through:



- a short interview

- a paid trial project (USD $50)



The trial involves creating a lightweight AI-assisted content research workflow. More details will be shared during the interview.

title: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist
description:
Position: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist

Type: Full-Time, Remote (Philippines)

Salary: PHP 25,000 - 45,000 / month, depending on experience

Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours, with flexibility for supplier, distributor, and Amazon-related communication



About our Company



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade, wholesale, and e-commerce. We are building Amazon wholesale and private label operations in Canada and the United States, with a focus on long-term supplier relationships, organized execution, and data-driven decision-making. Our company values professionalism, clear communication, and practical execution. We are establishing a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.



Role Overview



We are seeking an Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist to execute and manage key parts of our Amazon wholesale workflow across Canada and the United States. This role combines Amazon wholesale product research, supplier sourcing, distributor and brand outreach, account applications, onboarding, follow-ups, and daily workflow execution.



This is a main execution role, not a passive support role. The main purpose is to find and validate viable Amazon wholesale opportunities, build and manage the supplier pipeline, keep supplier and product files organized, and move the workflow forward without constant supervision.

The exact focus may shift depending on business priorities, supplier responses, available catalogs, and current workflow bottlenecks.



NOTE: General VA, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, customer service, or basic admin experience alone is not suitable for this role. Candidates must have direct Amazon product research, Amazon wholesale, supplier sourcing, supplier communication, or e-commerce operations experience.



Key Responsibilities:



• Conduct Amazon wholesale product research using Amazon, Keepa, SellerAmp, Seller Central, Google Sheets, and other available Amazon research tools.

• Evaluate product demand, pricing, Buy Box behavior, FBA competition, seller count, Amazon presence, reviews, sales rank, gating status, brand restrictions, and estimated profitability.

• Screen supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, brand search results, distributor product lists, and product files to identify viable Amazon wholesale opportunities.

• Research and identify potential wholesale distributors, brands, manufacturers, and suppliers in Canada and the United States.

• Contact suppliers, distributors, and brands by
 or web form and follow up professionally.

• Complete wholesale account applications, supplier forms, distributor onboarding forms, and account setup documents.

• Request and organize wholesale pricing, catalogs, MOQ, case pack details, stock availability, lead times, shipping terms, payment terms, and account requirements.

• Confirm whether suppliers allow Amazon, FBA, online marketplace sales, reseller accounts, or require written marketplace approval.

• Maintain supplier trackers, distributor trackers, application status sheets, outreach logs, product screening files, and follow-up lists.

• Organize supplier folders, application screenshots, pricing lists, catalog files, account notes, product research notes, and communication records in Google Drive.

• Coordinate with prep centers, suppliers, distributors, and internal tea
mbers when needed.

• Use AI tools to draft, organize, summarize, and check work, while carefully verifying accuracy.

• Prepare clear daily updates showing completed work, links, blockers, risks, and next steps.

• Flag supplier issues, application blockers, missing documents, marketplace restrictions, pricing problems, weak products, poor-fit suppliers, or workflow delays early.

• Support both Amazon Canada and Amazon US wholesale workflows as the business expands.



Qualifications:



• 2-4 years of direct Amazon FBA wholesale experience required, including Amazon product research, wholesale product screening, supplier sourcing, distributor outreach, brand outreach, Amazon operations, and wholesale account setup.

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, Keepa, SellerAmp, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, and distributor application workflows required.

• Strong understanding of wholesale product viability, including demand, pricing, competition, Buy Box, seller count, Amazon presence, fees, profitability, gating, and brand restrictions.

• Strong written English and professional supplier communication skills.

• Highly organized and able to manage multiple product research tasks, supplier conversations, applications, files, follow-ups, and status trackers at the same time.

• Comfortable following SOPs, checklists, templates, company instructions, policies, and structured workflows.

• Strong attention to detail with product data, pricing, supplier information, application forms, account requirements, and status tracking.

• Able to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and keep work moving without constant supervision.

• Comfortable asking clear questions, reporting blockers early, and providing practical updates.

• Must be comfortable with both Amazon product research and supplier-side communication, not only one side of the workflow.

• Must be reliable, responsive, and consistent with daily execution.

• Must be up-to-date with AI tools and actively use them to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, decision-making, and workflow speed.



KPIs / Success Measures:



• Quality and accuracy of Amazon wholesale product research and screening decisions.

• Ability to identify viable wholesale opportunities and reject weak products or poor-fit suppliers quickly.

• Number and quality of relevant suppliers, distributors, brands, catalogs, and product opportunities researched.

• Quality and consistency of supplier, distributor, and brand outreach.

• Accuracy and completeness of wholesale applications, onboarding files, supplier records, and product research files.

• Speed and quality of follow-ups without losing professionalism or accuracy.

• Organization of Google Drive folders, trackers, supplier records, product screening files, and daily work files.

• Ability to identify supplier restrictions, Amazon marketplace issues, gating issues, application blockers, pricing issues, and workflow risks early.

• Low error rate in forms, supplier details, pricing data, product information, and tracking sheets.

• Clear communication of completed work, blockers, risks, action items, and next steps.

• Ability to take ownership of the wholesale workflow and improve execution over time.

• Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards.



What We Offer:



• Full-time remote/hybrid work opportunity with a Canadian company.

• Long-term opportunity as the Amazon wholesale business grows.

• Structured SOPs, templates, and workflow support.

• Direct communication with company management.

• Opportunity to work across Amazon product research, wholesale sourcing, supplier operations, and marketplace expansion.

• Opportunity to grow into a more senior role as the business reaches revenue and expands.

• Performance-based growth opportunities.

title: Tech Lead
description:
WeFlex exists to increase the life expectancy and quality of life for people with a disability, people in aged care, and Australian war veterans — through access to physical fitness, allied health, and therapy supports.



We've delivered over 50,000 sessions of support across our network, grown 30x over the last 2.5 years, and want to continue at a rate of 100% year on year.



The seat

You'll own the technology engine that powers WeFlex's end-to-end customer lifecycle — lead acquisition through retention. Today it runs across Supabase, Airtable, n8n, GoHighLevel, Zendesk, Aircall, Wavix, Xero, and our internal portals. Tomorrow it's your call to architect.



You sit at the leadership table as a senior peer — reporting to our COO, partnering directly with the CEO, working alongside our Heads of Sales, CS, Marketing, and (soon) Service Providers.



This is a player-coach seat. You don't just architect — you build. Then you lead a team of 5 builders to ship alongside you. Big problems we're chewing on right now: the O2C rebuild (kill Zoho), the Supabase migration (centralise source-of-truth), the AHP supervision automation that's worth ~$185k/yr in revenue if we get it right.



AI augmentation is non-negotiable. We move at a pace where the only way to keep up is to have Claude / GPT / Cursor / equivalents deeply embedded in how you think and ship every day. If they're not already core to your workflow, this role isn't for you.



The 5 things you'll do day-to-day:



Set the technology strategy — what we build, what we migrate, what we kill. The 18-month roadmap is yours to author with the COO + CEO.

Architect + build — you write the spec, then you ship the work. We don't promote you out of code. The team builds with you, not for you.

Lead and grow the team — hire, performance manage, build capability, exit underperformers when needed. We have 5 builders today; you'll shape the next 10.

Partner directly with CEO + COO — translate ambiguous business problems into systems that work. "Clients aren't reporting back" ? you diagnose, scope, ship.

AI-augmented by default — Claude, GPT, Cursor, equivalent are part of how you ship every day, not just how you write
s. Show us your stack and a real recent build where AI was core to how you executed.

What we're looking for

We hire skills over credentials.



AI-augmented operator (non-negotiable). Your workflow runs through Claude / GPT / Cursor — diagnosing, scoping, building, documenting. If AI is bolted on rather than core, this role won't work.

Builder of systems with real artifacts. Operational systems / integrations / automations you've shipped end-to-end. Portfolio over CV. Show us the code, the flows, the Looms.

Architectural judgment at scale. You've made build-vs-buy / migrate-vs-rebuild calls. You've owned a platform decision and can defend it. You think in trade-offs, not absolutes.

Track record leading a small tech team. Hiring, performance management, capability building, hard conversations. We have 5 builders; you'll d
 who stays, who grows, who goes.

Translates ambiguous executive briefs into shipped systems. When the CEO says "we need to know which clients are at risk" — you diagnose, scope, build, ship. You don't wait for the perfect spec.

Degree, years-of-experience, prior industry — all signals, not gates. If your work speaks, your CV doesn't have to be conventional.



What this role does NOT involve

? Marketing tech / GHL funnel design ? marketing team owns this

? Direct customer service ? CS team owns Zendesk as a product

? Heavy DevOps / infrastructure architecture ? we're a small remote team running on managed services

? Mobile / native app development ? we run web + portal stack

Compensation

PHP 90,000–220,000 per month depending on experience and demonstrated capability

Fully remote, AEST-aligned working hours

Career trajectory: This is the technology counterpart to our COO-track seat. For the right person, ownership expands as we scale — through Head of Engineering and beyond — as WeFlex grows.

To apply

Submit your application here: 



The application has two parts:



Part 1 — Application form



Your CV

title: Content Marketing Producer
description:
Content Strategist modAmbition | Dr. Tiffany Shelton

Location: Fully remote Hours: 25 hours per week 

Start: June 15, 2026 Job Type: 

Freelance 1099 contractor position

Hey, I'm Dr. Tiffany. I'm the founder of modAmbition, a brand and content ecosystem for women who want to build a life that feels spacious and sustainable. I'm a neuropsychologist by training, an entrepreneur by passion, and a wife and mom of two by the grace of God.

I'm running two content channels (YouTube and Instagram) alongside our growing
 list, and preparing for a course launch in August. I've been carrying the research, packaging, and creative direction myself, and the channels need someone who can hold the strategy side alongside me so they can actually grow.

So I'm hiring my Content Strategist.

Who You'd Be Helping

My audience is ambitious women who are smart, driven, and quietly tired. They're moms, entrepreneurs, executives, and creatives who've built impressive lives and want to keep building with their nervous systems intact. My content gives them practical systems backed by neuroscience and softened by faith and grace.

My brand sits at the intersection of productivity, neuroscience, and faith based personal development. If that world already lives in your watch history and your feed, you'll feel right at home here.

What You'd Own

This is a collaborative role. I provide the topics and the teachings. You research, package, and shape each piece so it actually lands.

Here's how that breaks down.

YouTube research and packaging

I'll send you 4 video topics at a time. From there, you'd:

Research validated packaging using tools like ViewStats and 1of10 (outlier thumbnails and titles in our niche)

Bring me 3 thumbnail concepts and a handful of title variations for each video

Write the intro for each video (hook, framing, and why this matters to my audience)

Manage the editor handoff once I batch film, and run point on the review cycle

Watch performance after each video is published so we know what to do more of.

Instagram research and frameworks

Each week, you'd deliver a research package for 3 Instagram posts that we’ll work together to create. Each post framework includes:

Validated topics that align with what's working in our niche

Hooks for each carousel or broll reel tested against current content trends

Inspiration posts for each (an example we can reference for structure or angle)

Notes on the angle or series this fits into

Once I provide copy for the actual value provided in the carousel or reel (beyond the hook you created), you'd design 2 to 3 carousels per week, and create 1 broll reel per week, and hand them off to our executive assistant for scheduling. 

Finally based on the final carousel or reel created, you’d write captions in our voice. 

You'd also help me validate series ideas and longer arcs for Instagram so we have a clearer editorial direction month to month.

Coordination

You'd run point with the editor and any other tea
mbers in the content pipeline. You'd own the briefs, the feedback, and the timelines so I can stay focused on creating and coaching.

Who You Probably Are

You live in content. You scroll YouTube and Instagram the way some people watch the Super Bowl, with strong opinions about hooks, packaging, and what makes someone stop mid scroll.

You love research and pattern recognition. You can spend an afternoon inside ViewStats or analyzing top performing Instagram accounts and come out energized.

You're plugged into content for ambitious women. You follow the creators making it, watch how it resonates, and notice the trends shifting in this space.

You take deadlines seriously. When you say something will be done by Friday, it's done by Friday. If something comes up, you flag it early.

You're warm and direct. You can give and receive feedback without ego. You ask good questions and you don't make excuses.

You're a fluent English speaker and writer. The intros and hooks you write have to feel like me, and that takes a real ear for tone and rhythm.

You've got at least 1 to 2 years of experience in YouTube research, packaging, or content strategy work. Bonus if you've supported a course launch.

A Note On AI

The writing has to be yours. I'm hiring a real human creative partner who can think, feel, and craft alongside me. If I wanted intros and hooks that AI wrote, I could generate those myself.

AI is fine as a research helper or a brainstorm tool. The intros, hooks, and writing that go out under my name need to come from your brain and your voice. That's the whole job.

Tools We'll Use

Notion and Google Drive for daily work. YouTube and 1of10 for YouTube research. Klaviyo for
 coordination and Calendly for scheduling.

What I'm Offering

You'll have flexibility on your hours and schedule. Outside of agreed deadlines and meetings, you run your own day.

You'll work in a trust based environment. I don't micromanage. I set clear expectations and trust you to deliver.

There's real growth potential here. As the brand grows, your role and pay can grow with it. I want the right person to be here for the long haul.

You'll be part of a creative partnership rooted in something deeper than hustle. The content we make helps women all over the world build calmer, more aligned lives.

Compensation

Compensation will be discussed during the interview process based on your experience and the time commitment we land on.

How This Starts

We'll start with a 30 day paid trial. If we both feel the fit, we'll extend into a longer engagement. After 90 days, we'll talk about what the long term looks like.

To Apply

Fill out the application form here: 
 



One question will ask if there's anything else you'd like me to know. Please include the word "Apple" in your response so I know you read this whole thing.



I read every application personally.

Namaste, Dr. Tiffany

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor (Premiere Pro + After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve), 

Full-Time Remote, UK Agency



About Us

We're a London-based creative content consultancy producing short-form 

social content for a small portfolio of growing brands. Tight team, fast 

pace, no bureaucracy. Strict NDA on client names.



The Role

You'll edit 10 to 20 short-form pieces per week in Premiere Pro with After 

Effects, or DaVinci Resolve with Fusion — your call, work in whichever you 

ship fastest in. Footage and assets are delivered to you via Frame.io and 

Google Drive. You cut, caption, motion-design, sound-design, colour, and 

export to spec. We review, you revise, we ship.



What you'll be editing (three repeating formats)



1) Podcast clips, talking-head with motion design

   60 to 90 second vertical cuts pulled from long-form podcast recordings. 

   Two-camera setup, separate audio tracks. Punchy hooks in the first 3 

   seconds, animated captions on-brand, lower thirds, light motion graphics 

   (kinetic type, callouts, simple transitions). Sometimes paired with a 

   matching square carousel for LinkedIn (5 to 8 slides in After Effects 

   or Resolve Fusion, exported as PNGs or 1x1 video).



2) Talking-head videos with supplied B-roll

   30 to 90 second vertical or square edits where we send you the A-roll 

   (presenter to camera) and a B-roll package. You cut the talking head 

   tightly, motivate B-roll insertions, add captions, light sound design, 

   colour-match A and B-roll. No need to source footage — it's all supplied.



3) Static and animated carousels (occasional)

   LinkedIn and Instagram square carousels built from supplied copy and 

   brand templates. 5 to 10 slides. Sometimes a short animated version for 

   the lead slide.



Weekly deliverables

- 10 to 20 short-form pieces, mostly 15 to 90 seconds

- Burned-in captions, brand-styled per client, accurate to audio

- B-roll cutaways motivated by content (not pasted on top)

- Light motion design (kinetic captions, callouts, lower thirds, end cards)

- Clean H.264 exports to platform spec (1080x1920, 1080x1080, 1920x1080)

- Organised project files returned to shared drive



Must have

- Fluent in either Premiere Pro + After Effects OR DaVinci Resolve + Fusion

- Strong captioning craft (kinetic, on-brand, accurate, not auto-generated 

  garbage)

- Portfolio of at least 5 short-form edits you personally cut, including 

  at least one podcast clip and one talking-head with B-roll

- Fluent written and conversational English

- Wired internet, minimum 50 Mbps down / 20 up

- Machine able to run your chosen software smoothly, minimum 16GB RAM, 

  dedicated GPU

- Daily 4-hour overlap with UK hours (3pm to 11pm Manila works)



Nice to have

- Real motion design chops (kinetic type, simple 2D animation in AE or Fusion)

- Carousel and static design (Photoshop, Illustrator, or Figma)

- Sound design and audio cleanup (iZotope RX, Fairlight, Audition)

- Real colour grading beyond auto-balance

- Familiarity with Frame.io, Notion, Slack



Pay

£500/month flat (approx PHP 35,000), paid via Wise on the 1st. 

60-day review for raise to £550 to £650 based on quality and ownership.

Paid trial task before hire: $40 USD flat on delivery.

13th-month bonus paid in December as standard.



Mon to Fri, 6 to 8 hours daily. Your weekends are yours.



How to apply

1. Start your
 with the word "PARSNIP" as the first line.

2. Send to 

   a) A 60-second Loom introducing yourself, showing your editing machine, 

      and explaining one decision you made on a recent edit and why.

   b) Links to 3 short-form edits you personally cut. At least one podcast 

      clip and one talking-head with B-roll. Tell me which one you're most 

      proud of and which one you'd redo.

   c) Screenshot of fast.com speed test and your software version numbers.

   d) Your monthly rate expectation.

   e) One sentence: "What's the most common mistake editors make on 

      the first 3 seconds of a short-form video?"

3. Subject line: PARSNIP, Short-Form Editor, [Your Name]



We respond within 5 working days to every application.

title: Long-Form Video Editor | YouTube (Vlog / Talking-Head / Whiteboard)
description:
I'm Basit Oyebanji. In the last 18 months, I've generated over $2.7M in the online sales space.



I run a group mentorship and a 1:1 intensive called The Haven Freedom Protocol, helping athletes and 9–5 workers earn $3k–$10k+ per month online in 90 days or less.



I'm not a guru with a microphone. I walked the path first. Now I coach people through it.



I already have a full team running:



-SDR

-Content Strategist

-Strategic Advisor

-Calendar Manager

-Creative Director handling content systems



This isn't a one-man startup. It's a real operation being scaled intentionally.



Why I'm Hiring



There’s no dedicated long-form editor on the team yet. The YouTube channel is being built properly, and I need someone who actually understands what that means.



This isn't just “cut out the silences and add music.”



Long-form is storytelling. It’s retention. It’s the thing that turns a stranger into a believer before they ever book a call.



I need someone who understands pacing, knows when to hold a 
nt and when to cut, and can make a 15-minute vlog feel like it flew by.



The channel is still young. That means whoever joins now helps build the standard instead of inheriting someone else’s template.



What You’ll Edit



-YouTube vlogs featuring travel, training, and behind-the-scenes content (Cape Town, Barcelona, Miami, Lagos)

-Talking-head and whiteboard breakdowns covering sales frameworks, mindset, and athlete-to-business mapping

-Podcast-style edits with guest conversations and long-form interviews

-Cinematic, natural-light, documentary-style content that feels authentic, not overly polished or corporate



What I Need From You



-You’ve edited long-form content before. YouTube, documentary, or vlog experience is preferred, but what matters most is your ability to maintain pacing across 10–20 minutes without losing viewers.

-You communicate clearly. If a deadline is at risk, I want to know before it’s missed, not after.

-You understand the brief without needing constant repetition. Watch the footage, feel the story, and know what belongs and what doesn’t.

-You take feedback professionally. The first few videos will involve back-and-forth collaboration. That’s normal. Revision is refinement, not criticism.

-You’re consistent. Video 10 should be better than Video 1, not a coin flip.



What Success Looks Like



First 30 Days



-First batch delivered on time

-Minimal revisions needed

-Strong communication and reliability

-I can trust the process



First 90 Days



-The channel has a clear visual identity

-Retention is trending upward

-Editing style feels aligned with the brand

-I can hand you raw footage and trust the final result



6 Months In



-You understand the brand deeply

-You proactively flag what’s working

-The channel is compounding consistently

-You feel like a real extension of the team



Apply here: 
/to/wNSn6JZE



The application takes around 8–10 minutes. Some questions are designed to make you think intentionally.



It includes: A sample edit using my footage &  A short Loom recording introducing yourself

No templates. No copy-paste answers. Every application is reviewed personally.

title: Medical Content Producer
description:
Job Title: Medical Content Producer

Job Type: Full-Time / Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday

Compensation: $565–$1,305/month USD (depending on experience)



About the Role

We are a US-based digital health media company producing daily medical news content across social media platforms. We are looking for a detail-oriented, highly organized Medical Content Producer to serve as the editorial backbone of our daily content operation. This person is responsible for finding, researching, and verifying the medical stories we cover each day, and transforming them into polished long-form scripts and carousel content that educates and engages our audience.

This is a role for someone who genuinely loves medical news, takes accuracy seriously, and can work independently to meet daily production deadlines.



Daily Responsibilities

News Monitoring & Story Selection



Monitor news aggregators, Google Alerts, Google News, and Feedly each morning for trending and breaking medical news

Review primary sources including CDC, NIH, FDA, WHO, and peer-reviewed journals to identify and verify newsworthy stories

Scan consumer-facing health news outlets including Stat News, MedPage Today, Medscape, and Medical News Today

Select 5–7 of the most relevant, accurate, and audience-appropriate stories each day for content coverage

Maintain a daily story tracker in Google Sheets or Notion documenting selected stories, sources, and key facts



Long-Form Script Writing



Write one fully researched, production-ready script per day for a 7–10 minute medical news roundup video show

Scripts must be conversational, accurate, clearly sourced, and written for a general audience

Scripts should include natural transitions between stories, a strong opening hook, and a clear closing

Submit completed scripts by an agreed-upon daily deadline



Carousel Content Creation



Create one to two carousel posts per day (5–7 slides each) based on the day's selected stories

Each carousel should include a strong headline slide, supporting information slides, and a call-to-action slide

Write all carousel copy in clear, accessible language appropriate for social media audiences

Lay out carousels in Canva or an equivalent tool, following brand guidelines provided





Weekly Responsibilities



Maintain and update a content calendar tracking all stories covered, scripts completed, and carousels produced

Flag emerging health trends or recurring topics that could become series or recurring segments

Participate in a weekly team check-in via Zoom or Google Meet





You Are a Strong Fit If You:



Have a background in health sciences, nursing, medicine, public health, journalism, or communications

Write clean, accurate, conversational English at a native or near-native level

Are comfortable reading and interpreting peer-reviewed medical research

Can simplify complex medical findings for a general audience without sacrificing accuracy

Are highly organized, self-directed, and able to meet firm daily deadlines

Have strong attention to detail and take medical accuracy seriously

Are familiar with US health media and current health topics





Bonus Points For:



Experience writing scripts for video content

Familiarity with PubMed, NIH databases, or medical journals

Experience using Canva for social media content creation

Knowledge of health disparities, women's health, or minority women's health topics

Experience with Notion, Google Workspace, Feedly, or similar tools





To Apply, Please Submit:



Your resume or CV

Three writing samples — at least one must be health or medical related

A short video introduction (2–3 minutes) telling us about yourself, your background, and your interest in health and medical content

A brief writing test: Find a current medical news story, write a 200-word summary of it as if explaining it to a general audience, and list the primary sources you used to verify it

title: Business Development for UK Accounting Firm
description:
