We are a growing UK-based accounting and bookkeeping practice providing comprehensive financial services to small and medium-sized businesses across the UK. We are expanding our client base and are looking for a motivated, organised individual to support our business development efforts through structured outreach.



About the Role

This is a one-month freelance engagement focused on lead generation and cold
 outreach on behalf of a UK accounting firm. You will be responsible for building targeted prospect lists, executing a structured 3-step
 sequence (guidelines and templates provided), and warming leads through to a calendar booking with the firm's director.

This is not a high-volume spray-and-pray role. 

This is structured, professional, targeted outreach to specific types of UK businesses — quality over quantity. You will be sending a maximum of 5
s per day, scheduled in advance, meaning the role is manageable in a few focused hours per week.



Estimated hours: 5–10 hours per week

Hourly rate: $5.00 USD per hour



Bonus structure:

$10 USD for every qualified lead who books a call on the director's calendar (paid after the call takes place).

$40 USD for every client who signs up for a monthly bookkeeping or accounting package (paid after the client's 2nd invoice payment is received by the business).

If you are good at this, the bonuses will significantly exceed your base pay.

(Please note bonuses will not be paid for filling the calendar with time wasters). 



Your Ideal Client Target

- We are looking for UK-registered Ltd companies that fit the following profile:

UK Ltd company (London-based preferred, but all UK accepted — international companies with a UK Ltd entity are also valid)

Small to medium-sized businesses with relatively straightforward financials

Business owners or directors who are actively running their company and would benefit from outsourced bookkeeping, monthly management accounts, and a proactive accountant relationship

Industries: professional services, consultancies, agencies, e-commerce, retail, tech startups, and similar



The dream client for our business is a small business (£100k+ rev /year) owner who wants clean books, monthly reports, and a knowledgeable firm they can pick up the phone to — on a simple monthly retainer. That is who you are targeting.



Key Responsibilities:

Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn search, the Companies House API (free), and AI tools

Identify newly incorporated UK Ltd companies via Companies House (daily new registrations)

Scope job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Reed) for businesses advertising for bookkeeping or accounting roles — these are warm leads actively seeking the service we provide

Monitor LinkedIn for distress signals — businesses posting about accounting problems, late filings, HMRC issues, or switching providers

Execute a 3-step structured
 sequence per prospect, following firms provided guidelines and templates

Send a maximum of 5 outreach
s per day, scheduled in advance

Track all leads, outreach activity,
 status, and outcomes in an excel/sheets tracking sheet — every contact must be logged

Warm leads through to a calendar booking with firms director

Report weekly on activity, pipeline, and results



Essential Requirements:

Proven experience in business development, lead generation, or cold outreach

Strong written English — all outreach is professional and on behalf of a UK accounting firm

Comfortable using LinkedIn for prospecting and research

Able to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to assist with list building and research

Organised and self-directed — you will be given guidelines and expected to execute independently

Reliable, honest, and transparent — all activity must be accurately tracked



Desirable:

Familiarity with Companies House or UK business registration data

Experience with
 outreach tools or scheduling platforms (scheduling in Gmail is acceptable).

Understanding of UK small business landscape



Tools & Access:

A business
 account will be provided for outreach

Primary research tools: LinkedIn search and Companies House API (both free)

AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) encouraged for list research and enrichment

If a paid tool is genuinely required and clearly justified, this can be discussed — but the expectation is that the role is achievable using free and AI-powered resources

A lead tracking sheet will be provided



How to Apply

Please submit:

A brief cover message explaining your experience in lead generation or cold outreach

Any examples of previous outreach work or results achieved

Any service based busiiness outreach experience

Confirmation that you are comfortable working with UK-based business targets and professional
 outreach

title: Inbound Sales Appointment Setter (Remote, Full-Time, Pacific Time)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

ABOUT US



We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years.



Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from
 and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon.



This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments.



- Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM 
 and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel

- Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close

- Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy)

- Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar

- Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day)

- Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time



The most important 
nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most.





KPI TARGETS



This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day.



- Calls per day: 150 to 250

- Leads worked per day: 17 to 25

- Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher

- Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file)

- Bookings per day: 4 to 9

- Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160





WHAT WE NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING



Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls.



The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. We need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months.



Tech reliability is non-negotiable. The role does not work if your internet drops two or three times a week. I will ask about your backup plan (mobile hotspot or second ISP), and we will test your connection and audio live from your actual work setup before any offer.





REQUIREMENTS



- 6 to 12 months of phone-based sales, appointment setting, or BPO experience (4+ hours per day on the phone)

- Clear, neutral English with strong listening skills (you'll be talking to US-based women aged 35 to 65 all day)

- Comfortable with high call volume (150 to 250 dials per day) and a long-term commitment to that pace

- Strong script discipline and comfort operating inside a defined process

- Reliable home office setup: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB preferred), wired headset with boom mic, computer mouse, internet at 25 to 50 Mbps down and 10 to 20 Mbps up, ping under 50ms, and a real backup internet plan you have actually used

- Available Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines)



NICE TO HAVE



- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (CRM and phone)

- Experience with Stripe payment links

- Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon)

- Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care



COMPENSATION



- Base: $900 USD per month

- Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show

- Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows

- On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month

- PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period

- Payment: Paid through 
 on a regular schedule

- Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours.



To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here.





HOW TO APPLY



Submit a link to your updated resume, and Please send me a cover letter explaining:



1. Your most relevant phone-based sales or appointment setting experience (how long, what industry, what volume)

2. Your history with overnight shifts and how long you sustained that schedule

3. Your home internet speeds (down/up) and your backup plan

4. Whether you can commit to the Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM PST schedule for at least 12 months

SPEED RAMPS

sit perfectly together. The agent voice should

every project

title: Remote Sales & Customer Service Rep | $5/hr Base + Commission | US Hours
description:
CS & SALES SPECIALIST - HYBRID ROLE (REMOTE)

Wheels, Tires & Accessories



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are a fast-growing online wheels and tires retailer built around

lease-to-own and installment financing. We help customers across the

US get the setup they want on their vehicle today and pay over time -

and we do it primarily through text, call, and
.



We're looking for a sharp, people-first communicator to join our team

as a Customer Service (CS) & Sales Specialist. This is a fully remote,

phone and text-based role where you'll be handling both new sales

conversations and existing order support. If you're someone who's

great on the phone, catches on fast, and likes earning more when you

perform - keep reading.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



You'll be the first point of contact for customers reaching out

through our store line via call or text. On any given day that means:



- Helping new customers find the right wheels and tires for their

  vehicle (we have tools that make fitment easy - no prior

  automotive expertise required)

- Walking customers through our financing and lease-to-own options

  and helping them get approved

- Handling inbound questions about existing orders - tracking,

  delivery, reassurance

- Following up with warm leads (approved customers who haven't

  checked out yet, abandoned carts, denied applications)

- Confirming order details and flagging anything that needs attention

- Redirecting complex support issues through the right channels so

  nothing falls through the cracks



This is not a cold-calling role. Every conversation is inbound or

a warm follow-up.





COMPENSATION



Base Pay: $5.00/hr



On top of base, here's where it gets interesting:



- $10.00 per sale you were meaningfully involved in closing (we're

  generous with attribution - if you played a real part in the

  sale, it counts)

- $10.00 bonus for every 5 sales closed by you in a single work week

- Store-wide performance bonuses when the team is hitting strong

  numbers overall - we believe in sharing the win



The base is intentionally modest because the commission and bonus

structure is where the real earning happens. Reps who are active,

consistent, and good at following up earn significantly more than

the hourly rate alone.



You're also welcome to work after hours if you want to close more

sales and earn more commission - we allow this and support it.

After-hours CS work that falls outside commission territory is also

tracked and we do our best to compensate fairly.



Pay is sent every Friday, on time, every week.





SCHEDULE AND PLATFORM



Platform: Quo (formerly OpenPhone) - calls and texts managed from

one inbox



Shift A: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM EST

Shift B: Monday to Friday, 3 PM to 9 PM EST + Saturday and Sunday

         9 AM to 3 PM EST



You're welcome to work beyond your scheduled shift for additional

commission. On slower after-hours stretches where no sales come

through, we do our best to recognize that extra effort.



Call logic: First available rep answers the store line.

Text logic: Conversations are assigned to specific reps to keep

relationships consistent. Reps can assist each other's conversations

- just coordinate internally so two reps don't message the same

customer at the same time.





TOOLS YOU'LL USE



- Quo / OpenPhone - calls, texts, inbox management

- Shopify - pulling up orders, verifying customer details

- AI fitment tools - checking wheel and tire compatibility for

  customer vehicles (we provide full training on this)

- Our customer-facing website - product pages, cart, checkout flow

- Lender portals - checking approval statuses across multiple

  financing partners



No prior experience with these tools is required. We provide full

onboarding and an extremely comprehensive set of SOPs, scripts, and

paste-ins so you're never winging it.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Strong communicator - professional, warm, and clear on both

  calls and texts

- Detail-oriented - you read carefully and follow protocols

  without cutting corners

- Self-directed - you can manage your own queue, prioritize

  correctly, and stay on top of follow-ups without being

  micromanaged

- Coachable - you take feedback well and actually apply it

- Reliable - you show up for your shift and don't leave

  conversations hanging



Prior sales or customer service experience is a plus. Prior

automotive knowledge is not required - the tools and SOPs handle

the technical side. Anyone motivated can learn this quickly.





HOW IT WORKS DAY TO DAY



You'll work from a shared inbox. Inbound calls and texts come in

through the store line and get handled or triaged based on what the

customer needs. Sales questions get worked through scripts and

financing tools. Quick support questions get answered directly -

anything more complex gets routed to the right channel. Warm leads

get followed up on a structured schedule.



Everything is documented, recorded, and reviewed daily and weekly.

We audit calls and texts for quality and give real feedback - not

just to catch mistakes but to help you earn more.



If you're ever unsure about something on a call, you put the customer

on a brief hold, look it up in the SOP, or check with the manager.

We'd rather you take 30 seconds to get the right answer than give a

wrong one. We have the resources to handle almost any situation -

you just need to know where to look.





HOW YOU'LL RAMP UP



We don't throw you into the deep end. New reps go through a

structured onboarding before handling live conversations.



During training, we'll connect via Microsoft Teams, calls, and text

- so you'll always have a direct line to get questions answered

and feedback in real time.



Week 1: Learn the SOPs, tools, scripts, and how the business

works. You'll shadow real conversations before handling any.



Week 2: Start on inbound texts only - lower-stakes, written,

and easier to review. You'll get real feedback before moving

forward.



Week 3+: Sales texts and inbound calls once you're comfortable

and consistent. This is where commission starts stacking.



Eventually: Customer service responsibilities are added for reps

who've demonstrated reliability, judgment, and follow-through.

CS access is earned, not assumed.



The ramp exists because we'd rather you be confident and accurate

than fast and wrong. Most reps are handling a full workload within

their first month.





ESCALATION BOUNDARIES - WHAT'S NOT YOUR JOB



You handle sales, fitment, financing guidance, and order reassurance.

You do not handle:



- Refund approvals (routed to support
)

- Cancellations (routed to support
)

- Damage claims without shipping protection (routed to support
)

- Order processing or fulfillment (Operations Manager only)

- Financing account issues (routed directly to lender)



These have clear escalation paths built into every script. You'll

always know exactly where to send something.





GROWTH AND PROMOTIONS



This role has a real growth path for the right person. Reps who

perform consistently, follow protocols, and show leadership instincts

are considered first when senior rep and lead positions open up. We

promote from within when we can - the people who know the operation

best are the ones we want running more of it.





TO APPLY



Send your application message directly through OnlineJobs.ph.



Please include:



1. A short video (60 to 90 seconds) of yourself speaking in English.

   Talk about your background, why this role interests you, and what

   reliable means to you in a remote work setting. No scripts - we

   want to hear how you actually communicate. Upload your video to

   Loom, YouTube (unlisted), or Google Drive and paste the link in

   your message.



2. A few sentences about what you are looking for long-term. We are

   not hiring for a short contract or a side gig - we want someone

   who wants to grow with us.



Applications without a video will not be reviewed.



What we're looking for in that video:



- Neutral, easy-to-follow English - our customers are everyday

  Americans and need to understand you clearly and comfortably

  on a call

- Confidence and warmth - how you speak matters as much as

  what you say

- Someone who sounds like they actually want this, not just

  any remote job



100% of calls and texts are recorded for training and quality

assurance. By applying you acknowledge that all communications

on the store line are monitored.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

mber who understands the current workflow
